days.title: Arrival & Easy London Walk
days.summary: Arrive, check in, and keep the first day light with an easy central London walk.
notes: Keep this day flexible depending on arrival energy.
Good first-day orientation on foot.

days.title: British Museum & Bloomsbury
days.summary: A strong opening museum day with a classic Bloomsbury walk and optional literary additions.
notes: Suggested British Museum focus: Sutton Hoo, Rosetta Stone, British archaeology.
Optional literary stop: Dickens Museum or British Library Treasures Gallery.

days.title: Westminster & WWII
days.summary: A focused day on Churchill, Parliament, Westminster Abbey, and core national history.
notes: Book Churchill War Rooms in advance.
Poets’ Corner is an optional add-on inside Westminster Abbey.
River cruise is optional.

days.title: Tower of London & South Bank
days.summary: Major history in the morning, food and river walking in the afternoon.
notes: Tower of London is a major priority site; allow at least 2 hours.
Borough Market works well for lunch.

days.title: British Art & Chelsea
days.summary: British art in the morning followed by a slower neighborhood afternoon.
notes: Suggested Tate Britain focus: Turner, Blake, Pre-Raphaelites.
Saatchi Gallery is optional.

days.title: Rock & Popular Music Day
days.summary: A flexible guided or self-guided music-history day.
notes: This can be done as a guided tour or self-guided day.
Choose one live music venue in the evening.

days.title: South Kensington Museums & Parks
days.summary: Choose one or two museums, then use the parks for breathing room.
notes: Choose 1–2 museums rather than overloading the day.
Good recovery day after a denser run of sightseeing.

days.title: Day Trip Options
days.summary: Best match is Bletchley Park; several other classic day-trip options also work well.
notes: Bletchley Park is the strongest WWII option.
Only one of these day trips would be chosen in practice.

days.title: East London Food & Markets
days.summary: A market-and-food day with a more contemporary East London feel.
notes: Choose Borough Market or Maltby Street Market.
Tate Modern or National Gallery are optional adds depending on energy.

days.title: Final Morning & Departure
days.summary: A quiet final morning with a walk and brunch before departure.
notes: Keep this day light and close to departure logistics.
